review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: Mr Tyson reads the paper from cover to cover and argues with the radio: the media and their sources, coverage and fake news, elections, campaigns and candidates, the figures in a survey, and what the government says.
description.sl: Gospod Tyson prebere časopis od prve do zadnje strani in se prepira z radiem: mediji in njihovi viri, poročanje in lažne novice, volitve, kampanje in kandidati, številke v anketi in kaj pravi vlada.
description.it: Il signor Tyson legge il giornale da cima a fondo e litiga con la radio: i media e le loro fonti, la copertura e le fake news, le elezioni, le campagne e i candidati, le cifre di un sondaggio e quello che dice il governo.
description.de: Mr Tyson liest die Zeitung von vorn bis hinten und streitet mit dem Radio: die Medien und ihre Quellen, die Berichterstattung und Fake News, Wahlen, Kampagnen und Kandidaten, die Zahlen einer Umfrage und was die Regierung sagt.

words.example_en: The media came to the dale after the floods, and left a week later.
words.example_sl: Mediji so po poplavah prišli v dolino in čez teden odšli.
words.example_it: I media sono arrivati nella valle dopo l'alluvione e sono ripartiti una settimana dopo.
words.example_de: Die Medien kamen nach dem Hochwasser ins Tal und zogen eine Woche später wieder ab.
words.note: The media is used with is or are: both are heard.
words.note_sl: The media se rabi z is ali are: slišiš oboje.
words.note_it: The media si usa con is o are: si sentono entrambi.
words.note_de: The media steht mit is oder are: beides hört man.

words.example_en: The editor of the local paper changed my letter before printing it.
words.example_sl: Urednik krajevnega časopisa je moje pismo pred objavo spremenil.
words.example_it: Il redattore del giornale locale ha cambiato la mia lettera prima di stamparla.
words.example_de: Der Redakteur der Lokalzeitung hat meinen Brief vor dem Druck geändert.

words.example_en: The national coverage of the floods was better than people expected.
words.example_sl: Poročanje vsedržavnih medijev o poplavah je bilo boljše, kot so ljudje pričakovali.
words.example_it: La copertura nazionale dell'alluvione è stata migliore di quanto la gente si aspettasse.
words.example_de: Die landesweite Berichterstattung über das Hochwasser war besser als erwartet.

words.example_en: A journalist should always check her sources.
words.example_sl: Novinarka bi morala vedno preveriti svoje vire.
words.example_it: Una giornalista dovrebbe sempre verificare le sue fonti.
words.example_de: Eine Journalistin sollte ihre Quellen immer prüfen.

words.example_en: The headline was misleading: the school isn't closing, it's moving.
words.example_sl: Naslov je bil zavajajoč: šola se ne zapira, seli se.
words.example_it: Il titolo era fuorviante: la scuola non chiude, si trasferisce.
words.example_de: Die Schlagzeile war irreführend: Die Schule schließt nicht, sie zieht um.

words.example_en: Most of what Harry reads on his phone, says his mum, is fake news.
words.example_sl: Večina tega, kar Harry bere na telefonu, so po mamini oceni lažne novice.
words.example_it: La maggior parte di quello che Harry legge sul telefono, dice sua madre, sono fake news.
words.example_de: Das meiste, was Harry auf dem Handy liest, sei Fake News, sagt seine Mutter.

words.example_en: The police made a short statement to the press this morning.
words.example_sl: Policija je zjutraj dala kratko izjavo za tisk.
words.example_it: Stamattina la polizia ha rilasciato una breve dichiarazione alla stampa.
words.example_de: Die Polizei hat heute Morgen eine kurze Erklärung an die Presse abgegeben.

words.example_en: The government has promised more money for rural buses.
words.example_sl: Vlada je obljubila več denarja za podeželske avtobuse.
words.example_it: Il governo ha promesso più soldi per gli autobus di campagna.
words.example_de: Die Regierung hat mehr Geld für Busse auf dem Land versprochen.

words.example_en: If the election were held tomorrow, who would you vote for?
words.example_sl: Če bi bile volitve jutri, koga bi volil?
words.example_it: Se le elezioni fossero domani, per chi voteresti?
words.example_de: Wenn morgen Wahl wäre, wen würdest du wählen?
words.note: An election is countable: a general election, local elections.
words.note_sl: Election je števno: a general election, local elections.
words.note_it: Election è numerabile: a general election, local elections.
words.note_de: Election ist zählbar: a general election, local elections.

words.example_en: The campaign to save the village school was in all the papers.
words.example_sl: Kampanja za rešitev vaške šole je bila v vseh časopisih.
words.example_it: La campagna per salvare la scuola del paese era su tutti i giornali.
words.example_de: Die Kampagne zur Rettung der Dorfschule stand in allen Zeitungen.

words.example_en: Three candidates are standing for the county council.
words.example_sl: Za okrajni svet kandidirajo trije kandidati.
words.example_it: Tre candidati si presentano per il consiglio della contea.
words.example_de: Drei Kandidaten treten für den Grafschaftsrat an.
words.note: Stand for election: in British English candidates stand; in American English they run.
words.note_sl: Stand for election: v britanski angleščini kandidati stand, v ameriški run.
words.note_it: Stand for election: in inglese britannico si stand, in americano si run.
words.note_de: Stand for election: britisch stand, amerikanisch run.

words.example_en: The party's policy on farming hasn't changed for years.
words.example_sl: Usmeritev stranke glede kmetijstva se že leta ni spremenila.
words.example_it: La linea politica del partito sull'agricoltura non cambia da anni.
words.example_de: Die Agrarpolitik der Partei hat sich seit Jahren nicht geändert.
words.note: A policy is a plan or a rule; politics is the whole world of government.
words.note_sl: Policy je načrt ali pravilo; politics je politika kot dejavnost.
words.note_it: Policy è una linea o una regola; politics è la politica in generale.
words.note_de: Policy ist ein Kurs oder eine Regel; politics ist die Politik allgemein.

words.example_en: Hundreds of people joined the protest against the new road.
words.example_sl: Na stotine ljudi se je pridružilo protestu proti novi cesti.
words.example_it: Centinaia di persone hanno partecipato alla protesta contro la nuova strada.
words.example_de: Hunderte Menschen schlossen sich dem Protest gegen die neue Straße an.

words.example_en: The housing crisis is pushing young families out of the Lakes.
words.example_sl: Stanovanjska kriza izriva mlade družine iz Jezerskega okrožja.
words.example_it: La crisi degli alloggi sta spingendo le giovani famiglie fuori dai Laghi.
words.example_de: Die Wohnungskrise vertreibt junge Familien aus den Lakes.

words.example_en: According to the latest figures, fewer tourists came this year.
words.example_sl: Po zadnjih številkah je letos prišlo manj turistov.
words.example_it: Secondo le ultime cifre, quest'anno sono venuti meno turisti.
words.example_de: Nach den neuesten Zahlen kamen dieses Jahr weniger Touristen.

words.example_en: A survey found that most residents want a better bus service.
words.example_sl: Anketa je pokazala, da si večina prebivalcev želi boljše avtobusne povezave.
words.example_it: Un sondaggio ha rilevato che la maggior parte dei residenti vuole un servizio di autobus migliore.
words.example_de: Eine Umfrage ergab, dass die meisten Einwohner einen besseren Busverkehr wollen.

words.example_en: According to the forecast, the storm will reach Cumbria tonight.
words.example_sl: Po napovedi bo nevihta nocoj dosegla Cumbrio.
words.example_it: Secondo le previsioni, la tempesta arriverà in Cumbria stanotte.
words.example_de: Der Vorhersage zufolge erreicht der Sturm heute Nacht Cumbria.
words.note: According to someone else: never according to me (say in my opinion).
words.note_sl: According to za druge: nikoli according to me (reci in my opinion).
words.note_it: According to per gli altri: mai according to me (di' in my opinion).
words.note_de: According to für andere: nie according to me (sag in my opinion).

words.example_en: The report revealed that the river had been polluted for years.
words.example_sl: Poročilo je razkrilo, da je bila reka že leta onesnažena.
words.example_it: Il rapporto ha rivelato che il fiume era inquinato da anni.
words.example_de: Der Bericht enthüllte, dass der Fluss seit Jahren verschmutzt war.

words.example_en: The council has confirmed that the road will reopen on Monday.
words.example_sl: Občina je potrdila, da bo cesta v ponedeljek spet odprta.
words.example_it: Il consiglio ha confermato che la strada riaprirà lunedì.
words.example_de: Der Gemeinderat hat bestätigt, dass die Straße am Montag wieder öffnet.

words.example_en: The press were waiting outside the court.
words.example_sl: Pred sodiščem je čakal tisk.
words.example_it: La stampa aspettava fuori dal tribunale.
words.example_de: Die Pressevertreter warteten vor dem Gericht.

words.example_en: The garden at Hill Top is open to the public from April.
words.example_sl: Vrt v Hill Topu je od aprila odprt za javnost.
words.example_it: Il giardino di Hill Top è aperto al pubblico da aprile.
words.example_de: Der Garten von Hill Top ist ab April für die Öffentlichkeit geöffnet.

words.example_en: The latest opinion poll shows the two parties neck and neck.
words.example_sl: Zadnja javnomnenjska raziskava kaže, da sta stranki izenačeni.
words.example_it: L'ultimo sondaggio d'opinione mostra i due partiti testa a testa.
words.example_de: Die neueste Meinungsumfrage zeigt die beiden Parteien Kopf an Kopf.

words.example_en: The match will be broadcast live on the radio.
words.example_sl: Tekmo bodo v živo prenašali na radiu.
words.example_it: La partita sarà trasmessa in diretta alla radio.
words.example_de: Das Spiel wird live im Radio übertragen.
words.note: Broadcast, broadcast, broadcast: the past is the same.
words.note_sl: Broadcast, broadcast, broadcast: preteklik je enak.
words.note_it: Broadcast, broadcast, broadcast: il passato è uguale.
words.note_de: Broadcast, broadcast, broadcast: die Vergangenheit ist gleich.

words.example_en: Sam listens to a podcast about brewing while he cleans the kettles.
words.example_sl: Sam med čiščenjem kotlov posluša podkast o varjenju piva.
words.example_it: Sam ascolta un podcast sulla birra mentre pulisce i bollitori.
words.example_de: Sam hört beim Reinigen der Kessel einen Podcast übers Brauen.
